description: 黑后牺牲腾挪e3，让马跳入叉将
explanation_en: Black sacrifices the queen to vacate e3. The knight jumps into the cleared square with check, forking White's king and rook.

intro.popup: 💡 腾挪：黑方有Ne4/Ng4，e3格被白马占据。黑后能牺牲清开e3，让马跳入叉将吗？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Clearance: Black has a knight ready to jump to e4 or g4, but White's knight occupies e3. Can Black sacrifice the queen to clear e3 for a checking fork?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qxf3+！后牺牲腾挪e3——Ne3+叉击白王和白车，赢取子力！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qxf3+ sacrifices the queen and clears e3. Ne3+ then forks White's king and rook, winning material.

moves.popup: 黑后Qxf3+！牺牲自身，同时将军！后从e3移走，e3格清空——白王必须应将！
moves.popup_en: Black's queen captures on f3 with check, sacrificing itself and vacating e3. White's king must respond to the check.
White's g-pawn captures the queen, leaving e3 completely clear.

moves.popup: 黑马Ne3+！跳入腾空的e3，叉击白王和白车c2——腾挪成功！
moves.popup_en: The knight jumps to the cleared e3 square with check, forking the white king and rook on c2. The clearance succeeds.
The king moves to f2 to answer check, allowing the knight to capture the rook on c2.

moves.popup: 黑马Nxc2！赢得白车——后换车+马，腾挪战术大获！
moves.popup_en: The knight captures the rook on c2. Black has traded the queen for a rook and knight and wins material with the clearance tactic.
